title: Quick-Fix Saudi-Arabian Beans Bowl
description: Umami-rich Saudi-Arabian dish featuring crispy fried onions and flavorful infuse-oil, suitable for Jain-friendly diet.

ingredients.name: Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Infuse-oil (flavorful oil with Middle Eastern spices)

instructions: Heat 1 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the sliced onions until crispy, about 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the fried onions from the oil and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same oil, cook the minced garlic for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin and coriander powder to the oil and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the drained kidney beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the spices and oil.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and cilantro.
Serve hot, topped with crispy fried onions.
